data['End Borough'] = data['EndBorough']
departures = data.groupby('Start Borough')['Rental Id'].count().reset_index(name='Departures')
self_contained_trips = data[data['Start Borough'] == data['End Borough']].groupby('Start Borough')['Rental Id'].count().reset_index(name='Self Contained Trips')

# Compute Arrival share for each borough
total_arrivals = data['End Borough'].value_counts().reset_index(name='Arrivals')
arrival_share = total_arrivals.merge(departures, on='index', how='left').rename(columns={'Arrivals': 'Total Arrivals', 'Departures': 'Total Departures'})

expected_self_contained_trips['Expected Self Contained Trips'] = expected_self_contained_trips['Departures'] * expected_self_contained_trips['Arrival Share']

# Compute Self-Containment Index for each borough

cold_spots = self_containment_index[self_containment_index['Self Containment Index'] < 1]
